title: GradBridge - Student Mentorship & Alumni Network
description:
GradBridge is a full-stack web platform connecting university students and alumni for mentorship, networking, and career opportunities. It provides role-based user experiences, authentication, profiles, mentorship features, and opportunity sharing through a React frontend and Node.js/Express backend with MongoDB.
My Contribution: Designed and developed the responsive authentication pages and landing page, implemented client-side form validation, and established the project's UI/UX styling patterns using Tailwind CSS.
